request.digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; exact current-session live or admitted recovered original for current_stage, or an admitted ordinary root for complete_project
request.aliases: retain requested and actual identities; reject duplicate actual originals

forecast_scope.retained_continuation_custody: select the ordinary root; expand its exact linear continuation chain with a recovered prefix followed by optional current owned live stages, at most eight committed stages including root; predecessors Verified and physically quiet; final recovered stage may contain authenticated already-dispatched temporal monitors; wrappers cannot be selected separately
forecast_scope.current_stage_recovery: exact already committed original, including raw actions and a separately selected continuation; no project source, lineage expansion, restored handles or new stages

source.model: one discarded MemoryAdapter clone with existing live obligation runtimes and cloned authenticated recovered observation monitors
source.admission: current world plus complete retained original source union, reserve snapshots and owned competing receipts before clone; repeat derived-source admission
source.complete_project_originals: every root and retained descendant requires its exact retained sealed source; root stock-ledger identity/generation stays stable while each child ledger validates its own source-bound plan; sources, archives, receipts, reserve snapshots and predicates join the complete union before cloning
source.recovered_complete_project: ordinary durable recovery captures exact sealed-source anchor, qualified ledger, canonical records/bytes and ordinary source structural bytes/work; query charges their complete union with current/original/reserve sources and performs no archive reads or history hydration
source.recovered_reserve_endpoint: existing exact retained endpoint snapshot must already be present in bounded session history; otherwise refuse without hydration or replacing its first truth; an explicit selected wait may load previously published endpoint evidence
source.recovered_current_stage: ordinary recovery captures a ledger-independent exact sealed-source witness with canonical records/bytes, structural bytes/work, source anchor and complete typed plan object digest; admission compares the typed archive and charges historical source costs even without carried monitors; query performs no archive reads or history hydration

progression.tracked: all current-session open actions in original commit order; both scopes also observe all independently authenticated unfinished carried peers
progression.other_owners: already-dispatched physical work evolves; their deferred actions are not polled
progression.first_round: zero modeled ticks when horizon positive
clip_to: all unfinished carried peer cadences and original deadlines
progression.prune: terminal and physically quiet actions; retain original receipts
progression.new_project_stage: complete_project only: at most three hypothetical successors per selected root
progression.hypothetical_stage_order: ready actual original digests ascending; defer qualified tracked active-output conflicts while other ready originals proceed; existing and modeled action polls retain commit order
progression.active_output_conflicts: only the exact compiler-qualified canonical producer with matching tracked Active physical work may defer; bounded ordinary polling and recompile from observed stock; no future-output credit or new stage/action charge; untracked, unknown and other errors refuse
progression.new_stage_deadlines: own separately reviewed compiler-derived obligations; no original obligation is renewed
progression.retained_stages: reuse exact live receipts/runtimes or recovered original custody without preparing or recommitting; predecessors already Verified and physically quiet; final live stage may be prepared/active, final recovered stage must have authenticated already-dispatched temporal monitors
progression.recovered_originals: immutable historical census and original proofs; active monitor clones use the shared real observation transition, original deadline and retained post-recovery stability; no ActionIds, restored dispatch or reconstructed monitors

outcome.group_completion: all selected original goals true, required exact reserve samples true, original actions Verified and physical work quiet at one same modeled frontier
outcome.complete_project: all selected semantic goals and each root/retained pursuit exact reserve true; root, retained and hypothetical actions Verified and physically quiet at the same frontier
outcome.retained_stages: parent-ordered real identities, exact sources, unchanged obligations and independent reserves; custody already_committed_original for live, recovered_verified_original for historical, recovered_observation_original for unfinished recovered tip at admission; recommitted_by_forecast false
outcome.recovered_originals: complete original step rows with action_id null and immutable proof_anchor; historical origin verified_recovered_history; unfinished origin cloned_recovered_observation_monitor with distinct predicted_proof_anchor and predicted_proof_is_canonical false
outcome.recovered_current_stage: response /5 whenever any selected current_stage original is recovered; exact historical/provisional evidence remains distinct, action_id null, no future stages, no dispatch handles restored

authority.deferred_effects: original current grants and scope checked at modeled dispatch; no new grants
authority.recovery_only: both scopes admit historical Verified quiet steps and exact already-dispatched active temporal monitors under accepted recovery lineage; current_stage admits one exact raw or semantic original without requiring a project ledger or expanding lineage; complete_project retains Verified quiet predecessors, accepted recovered prefix and optional current owned live descendants
authority.future_stages: modeled Observe, Query, Plan, every effect scope/risk and checkpoint checked before charging or preparing the model stage
continued_project_refusals: gapped, cyclic, branched or duplicate lineage
changed typed root request or source family
foreign live stages, recovered stages after live stages, withdrawn or restore-abandoned custody
missing exact stage source, plan, commit or action custody
failed, cancelled, indeterminate or unknown physical stage work
cross-fortress, unaccepted cross-epoch or backward source lineage
recovered stages with different accepted recovery frontiers or malformed present live receipts
recovered_monitor_identity: complete normalized sealed obligation and combined postconditions
last observation within accepted recovery and current source
authority.recovered_peer_admission: both scopes: every unfinished carried peer passes full original custody and must have an authentic active temporal monitor; missing, interrupted, unknown, failed or never-dispatched work refuses the optional forecast

bounds.output: lossless full or compact Agent Turn; otherwise explicit refusal
bounds.hypothetical_costs: root, retained, competing and model actions share negotiated action/entity ceiling; all original archives and modeled plan archives share complete source byte allowance
bounds.recovered_original_steps: all selected recovered root/descendant steps and unselected unfinished carried peers share live/competing/hypothetical action ceilings; verified_recovered counts only historical steps at admission
bounds.recovered_observation_work: live and recovered polls share max_action_polls; recovered terminal/failure predicate visits share max_goal_predicate_node_bound
bounds.selected_recovered_current_stage: selected recovered steps count once alongside live and competing work; their carried rows are not additionally counted as unselected peers; all-historical selected originals still charge exact archived source and structural bounds

publication.complete_project_next_step: selected waits normally target the latest committed tips; reserve_capture reports the earliest unsampled frontier from the actual anchor and past missing count. At the exact tick the next wait explicitly captures up to eight outstanding original endpoints in actual digest order with zero time. Refresh after each capture.
